class.name: ResonanceProbeData
class.brief_description: Resource storing baked Steam Audio probe batch data.
class.description: Holds the serialized probe batch from a bake (reflections, optional pathing, optional static layers). Assign to [member ResonanceProbeVolume.probe_data]. Created and updated by the bake pipeline; save the scene or external resource after baking. Default external path pattern: [code]<scene>_<node_path>_batch.tres[/code] or [code].res[/code] (Project Settings -> Nexus -> Resonance -> Export -> Probe data format). [member baked_reflection_type] must be compatible with [member ResonanceRuntimeConfig.reflection_type] at runtime. When runtime pathing is on, [member pathing_params_hash] must be non-zero.

method.name: get_bake_layer_info
method.description: Editor/debug summary of baked layers. Keys include [code]total_size[/code] (int) and [code]layers[/code] (array of per-layer info).

members.member: Serialized Phonon probe batch bytes. Written by the bake pipeline; do not edit manually.
World-space probe positions stored at bake time for editor visualization.
Hash of volume layout and reflection bake parameters. Compared with [method ResonanceProbeVolume.get_bake_params_hash] to detect outdated reflection data.
Hash of pathing bake parameters. 0 when pathing was not baked.
Hash of the static scene used for the last bake. 0 when not recorded.
Hash of static source bake inputs ([member ResonanceProbeVolume.bake_sources], config). 0 when no static source layer.
Hash of static listener bake inputs ([member ResonanceProbeVolume.bake_listeners], config). 0 when no static listener layer.
Baked reverb algorithm: Convolution (0), Parametric (1), Hybrid (2). -1 = legacy (compatible with any runtime reflection type).
